ns0:text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

ns0:g.ns0:text: A runoff response transforms effective rainfall into a delayed direct-runoff hydrograph
Hypothetical linear response, one-hour effective-rainfall intervals and a one-mm unit hydrograph [0,0.12,0.08,0] m³/s at hourly points. Trapezoidal unit
volume720 m³ matches1 mm over0.72 km²;20 mm effective rainfall gives14400 m³ direct runoff. Baseflow is separate and constant here. Hydrograph ordinates
represent piecewise-linear interpolation; they are not design-event predictions.
